'''July 2001 Raleigh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Raleigh, North Carolina on 7 July 2001. It is known from Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2588">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-07-flying-is-fun-raleigh-7-7d2588/ flying-is-fun-raleigh-7-7], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 7 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-07-flying-is-fun-raleigh-7-7d2588/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Raleigh, North Carolina
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 24
